title: El centro de salud
goal: Get seen at a clinic and describe symptoms properly
culture: Public clinics are free and busy. She is triaging thirty people this morning, so the symptom comes first, the number of days second and the location third — in that order, in as few words as you can manage.

beats.good: Two words, first. She is seeing thirty people this morning and she is sorting them, not chatting.
Three days with a fever, in this country, is the number that gets you a blood test — because of what it might be.

beats.say: Me duele aquí, atrás de los ojos.
beats.en: It hurts here, behind the eyes.
ok: me duele aqui atras de los ojos
beats.good: Behind the eyes, with a fever, means one thing here. She will say the word before you do.

beats.es: Le voy a mandar un examen de sangre.
beats.good: The same two words you used on the moto in Guadalupe. They work on an engine and they work on a person.
